title: VegetationRules
description: What grows where. Lives in defs/biomes.json. Each layer scatters candidate spots on its own jittered grid; at each spot every rule of the layer gets a weight from the ground masks, the weights' sum is the chance that something stands there, and the species is drawn in proportion to the weights.

spacing.description: Grid cell size in metres: at most one object per cell.

batch.description: tile = placed per 256 m world tile and kept far out; patch = placed per 32 m patch near the camera only.

ranges.title: LayerRanges
ranges.description: Distances in metres out to which each representation is drawn.

species.description: Name of a file in defs/species.

biomes.description: Chance per grid cell in each land cover class, before the bands below scale it down.

elevation.description: Metres above (+) or below (-) the region's treeline.

size.title: SizeRule
size.description: Height of the instance in metres: either a share of the canopy height mask, or a range of its own.

canopy.description: Multiplier on the canopy height at the spot.

skew.description: With range: 1 spreads sizes evenly, 2 or 3 make small ones more common.

Band.title: Band
Band.description: Full weight inside prefer, none outside tolerate, sliding in between.
